legend-causeway-coastal-route.story: A coastal route from Belfast, Northern Ireland to Derry-Londonderry, Northern Ireland, via Carrickfergus. Key character: cliffs; glens; castles; basalt coast. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Causeway Coastal Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 15 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
